title: The Maestro's Activate button shows the price and exile count it will use
notes: The Maestro (Meditative #69): its Activate's label is now the template "Spend ({price}) Plague Counters: exile {exiles} from each enemy zone" the client fills from the card's current numbers, where it baked in the printed 4 and 1 (2 on its Radiant face). The words only: the price and the exile count the ability uses are unchanged. Only the view's label differs, which the classifier's forced games read as a different play.

player.title: The Maestro's button shows its real numbers
text: The Maestro's Activate button shows the Plague Counter price and exile count it will use, as other cards change them. The ability itself is unchanged.
